chunks: And it is narrated from Abū Baṣīr:

That Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام fell ill, so he ordered his attendants to carry him and perform tawaf with him. Then he ordered them to draw his foot along the ground so that his feet would touch the ground during the tawaf.
And in the narration of Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl from al-Rabīʿ ibn Khuthaym:
That he would do this whenever he reached al-Rukn al-Yamānī.

key_terms.الرُّكْنِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام perform tawaf while ill and being carried?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, while ill, was carried in tawaf and ensured that his feet touched the ground during it. A parallel report adds that this was done whenever he reached al-Rukn al-Yamānī, indicating a practical detail related to tawaf while being carried.
